description: Returns the land parcels nearest a point in Georgia, nearest first, with the cadastral code, the address, and the distance in metres. The first parcel at 0 metres holds the point. Get the owners and the area with parcels_get_parcel. Addresses are in Georgian. Data from NAPR.

limit.description: The maximum count of parcels, 1 to 20. The default is 5.

name: parcels_list_nearby_parcels

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the parcels, RFC 3339.

distance_m.description: The distance from the point, in whole metres. 0 when the parcel holds the point.

source.description: The source of the data: NAPR.

stale.description: Always false: a list near a point is never stale.

title: List the land parcels near a point in Georgia
